reference_job_info.description: Three stars chase each other around a figure eight. Velocity Verlet keeps the loop closed and the energy steady.
reference_job_info.name: Figure eight with Velocity Verlet

job_info.description: Three stars on a figure eight orbit, moved with Simple Euler, the most basic method. The stars slowly drift off the figure eight and the energy keeps growing.
job_info.name: Figure eight with Simple Euler

job_info.description: Three stars on a figure eight orbit, moved with RK4. It is very accurate, but it computes the forces four times per step.
job_info.name: Figure eight with RK4
